FOBO skill simulation: one step vs many steps

Agent One Finance · COB 2026-10-09 · books PRIME-SIM-01 and PRIME-SIM-02 · FOBO Investigation Skill v1.0

One data set, built so each break exercises one path of the skill, run through both setups on Agent One Finance after MB Rec's end-of-day event. The "expected" column is what the skill gives when followed exactly.

The model here is a simulator, not an LLM. It follows the skill step by step through the same MCP tools and gateway a real model uses, so the results are the skill's expected answers. In the office, the same runs use Claude through Agent One, and these answers become the eval set the real model is scored against.

Single step (steps: [agent])10 of 10 match the skillOne session per book; 10 tool calls for PRIME-SIM-01; every break decided individually in the skill's §12 format.
Multi step (break.investigation + fobo-prime)8 of 10 match the skill's verdictThe playbook settled the deterministic breaks without a model; three breaks no check explained went to the model as one judgement group.
BothA controller decides every breakFigures validated against the tool results; nothing written to a bank system.

Multi step "differs" only where the playbook has no rule for the skill's path (an FO price break, a trade booking break): those breaks go to the model as one "Novel" group, the model recommends per break, and a person decides. Adding checks for FO-2 and the trade level to the playbook would settle them.

How each setup ran

Single step

MB Rec event (book, COB)
  └ agent: ONE session with the skill and 10 tools
      book_status → breaks → cats/motif pnl_components
      per break: §8 static · §8 reapplication · FO-1..8
                 FO-6/FO-7 corporate actions · BO-1..6
                 §7 trades when FO and BO pass
      → one result per break (§12 sections)
  └ draft → validate (figures) → review → record

Tools: mbrec.book_status, mbrec.breaks, cats.pnl_components, motif.pnl_components, secref.corporate_actions, secref.bond_metadata, mbrec.break_history, cats.trades, motif.trades

Multi step

MB Rec event (book, COB)
  └ load (mbrec.breaks) → enrich (motif.break_snapshots)
  └ history, events, bo_positions, offsets, split bookings,
    systemic, near refs, trend, unusual (evidence)
  └ resolve → classify (playbook: checks, tests, findings)
  └ group → ⏸ controller tollgate
  └ reason: verdict table settles; model for judgement groups
  └ draft → validate → review → record

Tools: mbrec.breaks, motif.break_snapshots, mbrec.break_history_book, motif.booking_events, motif.positions, mbrec.breaks_all, cats.trades, motif.trades

The single-step answer for the worked example (Appendix A)

1. Break summary
EMB AMORT 2031 (XS2311110001), desk EM Credit, book PRIME-SIM-01, COB 2026-10-09. FO 0.00, BO -247,000.00, break 247,000.00.
2. Checks performed
FO-1 | Prior close position = open position | Pass | Position file FO-2 | Close price 98.4 = open price 98.4 | Pass | Pricing file FO-3 | Pull factor 1.00 -> 0.67 | Fail | Pull factor history FO-4 | Position x price movement explains MTM | Pass | Position and pricing files FO-5 | Trade economics explain Trading PnL | Pass | Trade file FO-8 | Holiday carry-forward | Pass | Pricing file FO-6 | Redemption occurred; factor changed; PnL expected; CATS calculated it? | Fail (finding A) | Corporate action file: expected PnL 247,000.00; CATS 0.00 Not performed: BO-1 to BO-6: not required, FO root cause established at FO-6
3. Root cause
Front office. CATS did not generate redemption PnL on the pull factor movement 1.00 -> 0.67; expected 247,000.00. MOTIF correctly reflected -247,000.00. FO-6 finding A: pull factor event missing.
4. Classification
C — Redemption break (secondary B — Pull factor break). Deterministic.
5. Verdict
DO NOT POST.
6. Remediation and follow-up
Notify the desk and product controllers; escalate to CATS support as a calculation failure on redemption events; raise a DQ incident with root-cause analysis. Check other amortising positions with factor moves on the same date (systemic?). Propose an MB Rec rule: factor movement present and redemption PnL absent in FO -> auto-exception.
7. End-state validation
Not applicable: no adjustment posted. Open pending the FO correction, then re-test BO + adjustments = FO.

Run it yourself

AOF_LLM_ADAPTER=agent_one_finance.stub_connectors.fobo_skill_simulator:FoboSkillSimulator \
AOF_EVENT_SECRET=demo uvicorn agent_one_finance.web.main:app --port 8300

# single step
curl -X POST localhost:8300/api/events -H 'X-AOF-Event-Secret: demo' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"capability_id":"break.investigation.skill","case_key":{"book":"PRIME-SIM-01","cob":"2026-10-09"}}'
# multi step
curl -X POST localhost:8300/api/events -H 'X-AOF-Event-Secret: demo' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"capability_id":"break.investigation","team_group":"fobo-prime","case_key":{"book":"PRIME-SIM-01","cob":"2026-10-09"}}'

With a real model, set AOF_LLM_ADAPTER=agent_sdk instead; the data, tools and steps stay the same.
